meta.title: BeeAPI balance
meta.description: Query balance through BeeAPI's read-only /v1/usage endpoint in DSH. Reuse the current key of a selected DSH chat or image channel by storing only its reference, or enter a manual key. Only HTTPS beeapi.dev channels are supported. Keys never reach the frontend. Disconnect leaves original channel credentials untouched. Unofficial plugin; refreshes after normally completed turns and coalesces nearby balance requests. No model requests.
